readout_other: meditative depth and intensity ratings (1-5) every ~4 min; heart rate, HRV, respiration rate, galvanic skin response; POMS, TMS, EDI, MEDI and other trait questionnaires
direction_notes: Inhibition-biased FUS: in long-term meditators caudate stimulation produced a steeper rise in meditative depth than sham and insula; in novices PCC stimulation did so; insula had no sham-relative effect; no target altered intensity.
safety_notes: Safety assessed by analytical and numerical estimates of mechanical index and thermal index (TIC 0.45-0.70 nominal); participants guessed sham versus real after each session.
